title: 激光原理与激光分级
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/112_激光原理与激光分级.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/112_激光原理与激光分级/src.py

points.K1: 功率越高，越要讲激光安全
points.K2: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
points.S1: 激光的特点与常见激光器
points.K3: 激光安全标准：国内看国家标准
points.K4: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一张标着不同级别的阶梯图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a staircase chart with seven steps of rising colour from green to red.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光原理和激光分级。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一支小激光笔，走向光学平台上的大激光器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a small laser pointer and walks towards a large laser unit on an optical table.
shots.narration: 阿杰想：激光不都跟激光笔一样？

shots.scene: 小研指着激光器机身上的标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at the product label on the side of the laser unit.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看标签，这台是3B类。

shots.scene: 阿杰愣住，把激光笔放回口袋
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks surprised and puts the laser pointer back in his pocket.
shots.narration: 级别不同，危险和要求差得远。

shots.section_title: 功率越高，越要讲激光安全
shots.scene: 台阶从小激光笔走到大功率激光器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: steps leading from a tiny laser pointer up to a large high power laser unit. No text.
shots.narration: 学得越深，用的激光功率越高。
overlay: 功率越高，越要讲激光安全

shots.section_title: 功率越高，越要讲激光安全
shots.scene: 激光束射向眼睛，打警示符号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser beam heading towards an eye, with a warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 激光最先伤的，往往是眼睛。

shots.section_title: 功率越高，越要讲激光安全
shots.scene: 分级、限值、控制、标志、事故、规则六个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: six icons in a row, a staircase, a gauge, a lock, a warning sign, a broken eye and a rule book. No text.
shots.narration: 从分级学起，再学伤害和防护。

shots.section_title: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
shots.scene: 原子被灌进能量，电子跳到高能级
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: energy being pumped into atoms, their electrons jumping up to a higher level. No text.
shots.narration: 激光器先给工作物质泵入能量。
overlay: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔

shots.section_title: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
shots.scene: 气体激光管通电，管内亮起淡紫色辉光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long gas laser tube switched on, a soft violet glow filling the tube. No text.
shots.narration: 气体激光开机，管里亮紫色辉光。

shots.section_title: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
shots.scene: 两端电极放电，新鲜气体沿箭头流过
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: electrodes discharging inside the tube while fresh gas flows through along arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 电极放电，新鲜气体不断流过。

shots.section_title: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
shots.scene: 一个光子经过激发的原子，变成两个一模一样的光子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one photon passing an excited atom and becoming two identical photons moving in step. No text.
shots.narration: 一个光子，引出一模一样的光子。

shots.section_title: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
shots.scene: 两面镜子之间光来回反射，越来越强
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: light bouncing back and forth between two mirrors, growing stronger each pass. No text.
shots.narration: 两面镜子来回反射，光越放越强。

shots.section_title: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
shots.scene: 一端是半透镜，细光束从这里射出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one end mirror partly transparent, a narrow beam leaving through it. No text.
shots.narration: 从半透镜射出来，就是激光束。

shots.section_title: 激光怎样产生：激励、受激辐射与谐振腔
shots.scene: 电源箱上画闪电符号，打开外壳打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power supply box with a lightning symbol, a hand opening its cover crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 放电要用高压，不能随便开壳。

shots.section_title: 激光的特点与常见激光器
shots.scene: 一条很窄的单色谱线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single narrow coloured line on a dark spectrum strip. No text.
shots.narration: 激光颜色很纯，几乎只有一个波长。
overlay: 激光的特点与常见激光器

shots.section_title: 激光的特点与常见激光器
shots.scene: 一排波峰对齐的波
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of light waves with their crests perfectly lined up. No text.
shots.narration: 光波步调一致，是相干光。

shots.section_title: 激光的特点与常见激光器
shots.scene: 手电光越走越散，激光束到远处还很细
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torch beam spreading wide while a laser beam stays narrow far across a long hall. No text.
shots.narration: 光束很细，传到远处还很集中。

shots.section_title: 激光的特点与常见激光器
shots.scene: 激光进入瞳孔，在眼底聚成极小亮点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser beam entering the pupil and focusing to a tiny bright spot at the back of the eye. No text.
shots.narration: 进眼后聚成极小一点，所以伤眼。

shots.section_title: 激光的特点与常见激光器
shots.scene: 五种激光器图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five laser icons, a gas tube, a crystal rod, a small chip, a coiled fibre and a liquid cell. No text.
shots.narration: 按工作物质，有气体、固体、半导体等。

shots.section_title: 激光的特点与常见激光器
shots.scene: 连续光束和一串脉冲，旁边一束看不见的虚线光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a continuous beam and a train of short pulses, beside a dotted invisible beam. No text.
shots.narration: 有连续和脉冲，很多波长看不见。

shots.section_title: 激光安全标准：国内看国家标准
shots.scene: 一本厚厚的标准手册放在桌上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick standards book lying on a desk with a laser icon on its cover. No text.
shots.narration: 激光安全标准，规定怎样安全用激光。
overlay: 激光安全标准：国内看国家标准

shots.section_title: 激光安全标准：国内看国家标准
shots.scene: 几本手册按年份排开，最新一本发亮
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several editions of a standards book lined up, the newest one glowing. No text.
shots.narration: 标准不断修订，用现行版本。

shots.section_title: 激光安全标准：国内看国家标准
shots.scene: 王老师认真翻阅标准并做笔记
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reads a standards book carefully and takes notes.
shots.narration: 激光安全负责人，要把标准吃透。

shots.section_title: 激光安全标准：国内看国家标准
shots.scene: 外文资料上的另一套台阶图，旁边国标手册打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a foreign style staircase chart with a question mark beside a national standard booklet with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 国外资料分级名称不同，以国标为准。

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 七级台阶，前四级颜色较浅
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a seven step staircase, the first four steps in light colours. No text.
shots.narration: 国标把激光产品分成七级。
overlay: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 台阶后三级颜色越来越深
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the last three steps of the staircase in deepening orange and red. No text.
shots.narration: 级别越高，危险越大，管得越严。

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 波长、功率、时间三个图标汇入一个台阶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a wavelength wave, a power meter and a clock, feeding into one step. No text.
shots.narration: 分级综合看波长、功率和时间。

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 厂家在激光器上贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a factory worker sticking a blank label onto the side of a laser unit. No text.
shots.narration: 级别由厂家确定，标在机身上。

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 【实拍】激光产品说明标签和激光警告标记特写（遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a laser warning label and a blank explanatory label on the side of a laser unit.
shots.narration: 用前先看清，这台激光是几级。

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 激光笔和大激光器并排，中间不等号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser pointer and a large laboratory laser side by side with a not equal sign between them. No text.
shots.narration: 激光笔和实验室激光器不是一回事。

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室门口的激光警告标志和激光工作指示灯（不开激光）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a laser warning sign on a laboratory door with a red indicator lamp above it.
shots.narration: 门口贴激光警告标志，开机亮灯。

shots.section_title: 按危害分级：先看标签上的级别
shots.scene: 标签被撕掉打叉，阿杰拍照报告王老师
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a torn label crossed out, then the young male student reporting it to the safety administrator. No text.
shots.narration: 标签不准撕，看不清要报告补贴。

shots.scene: 光路全封闭的小设备，绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small instrument with its beam fully enclosed inside, a green tick beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 1类：正常使用不会伤人。

shots.scene: 大功率激光装在封闭外壳里，外壳带门锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a high power laser sealed inside a closed cabinet with a locked door. No text.
shots.narration: 大激光装进封闭外壳，也能算1类。

shots.scene: 外壳盖板被打开，里面的强光露出来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the cabinet cover opened and the strong beam inside exposed, with warning symbols. No text.
shots.narration: 可一打开外壳，危险就回来了。

shots.scene: 人用望远镜看一束发散的光，打警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person looking at a wide spreading beam through binoculars, with a warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 带M的，用望远镜看就可能危险。

shots.scene: 低功率可见光激光照在屏上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a low power visible laser making a small dot on a screen. No text.
shots.narration: 2类是低功率的可见光激光。

shots.scene: 光一晃到眼睛，眼皮马上闭上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam flashing across an eye and the eyelid closing at once. No text.
shots.narration: 偶尔一晃，眼睛会本能地躲开。

shots.scene: 眼睛长时间盯着光点，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye staring at the laser dot for a long time, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 长时间盯着看，照样会伤眼。

shots.scene: 功率和时钟两个图标相乘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power meter icon multiplied by a clock icon equals a damage icon. No text.
shots.narration: 危害既看功率，也看照射时间。

shots.scene: 人用放大镜和望远镜看可见光束，打警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person looking at a visible beam through a magnifier and binoculars, with a warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 2M用光学仪器看，也可能伤眼。

shots.scene: 光束直射入眼，旁边小警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam heading straight into an eye with a small warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 3R类：直视光束有一定风险。

shots.scene: 望远镜把光会聚进眼睛，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: binoculars gathering a beam into an eye, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用望远镜聚光入眼，就危险。

shots.scene: 激光笔和光学平台上的指示光源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser pointer and a small alignment laser module on an optical table. No text.
shots.narration: 很多激光笔和指示光属于这一类。

shots.scene: 激光笔对着人、汽车、飞机，全部打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser pointer aimed at a person, a car and an aeroplane, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 激光笔不准照人眼、车辆和飞机。

shots.scene: 光束直射眼睛，大警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam heading straight into an eye with a large warning symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 3B类：直视光束就会伤眼。

shots.scene: 光束打到镜面反射进眼睛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam bouncing off a shiny mirror surface into an eye. No text.
shots.narration: 镜面反射的光，和直射一样危险。

shots.scene: 功率高的光束照到手背上，皮肤发红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a strong beam striking the back of a hand, the skin turning red. No text.
shots.narration: 功率高的，还会灼伤皮肤。

shots.scene: 光束打到白色粗糙屏上，散射光较弱，旁边小警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam hitting a white matte card, the scattered light weak, with a small caution symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 漫反射一般不伤眼，也别凑近看。

shots.scene: 小研戴上激光防护眼镜再开机
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on laser safety goggles before switching on the laser.
shots.narration: 用3B和4类，按规定戴防护眼镜。

shots.scene: 最高一级台阶上画火焰和眼睛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the top red step of the staircase marked with a flame icon and an eye icon. No text.
shots.narration: 4类是最高一级。

shots.scene: 光束打在粗糙表面，向四面散开，射到眼睛
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam hitting a rough matte surface and scattering in all directions, some reaching an eye. No text.
shots.narration: 连粗糙表面的漫反射都能伤人。

shots.scene: 光束点燃纸张冒烟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam setting a sheet of paper on fire with smoke rising. No text.
shots.narration: 4类激光还能引燃东西。

shots.scene: 眼睛和手臂都被保护起来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye behind goggles and an arm covered by a sleeve and glove, both with ticks. No text.
shots.narration: 眼睛和皮肤都要防护。

shots.scene: 光束一直伸向远处，远处的人也有警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam reaching far down a long hall, a person at the far end still marked with a warning. No text.
shots.narration: 离得很远，直射光也可能伤眼。

shots.scene: 激光切割机旁贴激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an industrial laser cutting machine with a laser warning sign on its side. No text.
shots.narration: 切割用的激光，就属于最高的4类。

shots.scene: 受激辐射和两面镜子图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, identical photons multiplying and a pair of mirrors. No text.
shots.narration: 受激辐射加谐振腔，产生激光。

shots.scene: 七级台阶，前段绿后段红
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the seven step staircase, green at the bottom and red at the top. No text.
shots.narration: 1到4类越来越危险，先看标签。

shots.scene: 3B、4类台阶旁画防护眼镜和锁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the top two steps with goggles and a padlock icon beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 3B和4类，必须严格管控。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一个大眼睛模型挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large eye model and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：激光对眼睛和皮肤的伤害。
